The supplied archive's License_Standard.txt explicitly identifies this free
Standard kit as CC0 1.0 Universal. Its original notice is included at
source/character/License_Standard.txt. The pack's Superhero Male body, facial
features, 65-bone rig, skin weights, Simple Parted hair and associated textures
were used. Source files from the supplied archive are preserved in that folder.

This MIT notice covers the original authoring source, equipment geometry,
custom exercise motion, documentation and preview production contributions,
to the extent rights exist in AI-assisted outputs. It does not relicense or
claim ownership of Quaternius's CC0 source assets. Keep this notice with
distributed application/assets. No on-screen credit is required.

Python, NumPy, SciPy, Pillow, FFmpeg and the C++ compiler are production tools,
not bundled runtime dependencies of the GLBs. DejaVu Sans is rasterized into
preview captions; no font file is included. Three.js is not bundled.

The motions are authored demonstrations, not motion capture, biomechanical
validation, exercise certification or diagnostic findings from an ML model.
